title: Demo · Breach of trust under the BNS, arrest without notice, papers missing
story: Accused-1, an accountant, is charged under BNS 316(2) for diverting Rs. 3,80,000 of his employer's collections, an offence punishable with up to five years. He was arrested on 05.10.2026 without a notice of appearance and without recorded reasons; counsel has only four papers, so intake asks what is missing and counsel answers from instructions.

variant.offence: BNS 316(2) criminal breach of trust (maximum 5 years), offence after 1 July 2024
variant.custody: arrest without a notice of appearance or recorded reasons (BNSS s.35(3), Arnesh Kumar; the radar shows UNKNOWN for the notice rule); default-bail window not yet open (day 40 of 60)
variant.record: four documents only: charge-sheet status, custody certificate, antecedents and earlier orders are missing, so intake asks
variant.parity: no co-accused; first-time offender (by counsel's answer); no earlier bail application

steps.title: Rights Radar
steps.caption: At intake Peshkar ran the 7 rules of the Rights Radar on the dossier as of 2026-11-14: date arithmetic and statute tables, not the language model. Default bail: NOT_YET, Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479): CHECK, Production within 24 hours: CHECK and Antil category: CHECK. Each result names its rule and the dates it used; rules not yet re-checked against the bare act are marked unverified.

filled.label: Default bail
filled.value: NOT_YET: 60-day limit (maximum 5 years). Day 1 is the first remand, 06.10.2026. As of 14.11.2026 it is day 40. The right arises on day 61 (05.12.2026), 21 day(s) from now, if no charge sheet is filed.

filled.label: Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479)
filled.value: CHECK: 40 days in custody. The threshold is 609 days for a first-time offender (1/3 of 5 years, on bond) and 913 days otherwise (1/2, on bail). Antecedents unknown.

filled.label: Notice of appearance
filled.value: UNKNOWN: Offence punishable up to 7 years. No arrest memo or notice in the file.

filled.label: Grounds of arrest
filled.value: UNKNOWN: No record that the grounds of arrest were communicated.

filled.label: Production within 24 hours
filled.value: CHECK: Produced the next day; times not on record.

filled.label: Antil category
filled.value: CHECK: Category A (up to 5 years), unless treated as an economic offence (D). Antil's categories decide how an accused who was not arrested during investigation and cooperated is treated after the charge sheet; for a client in custody this is context, not a bail entitlement.

filled.label: Statutory bar
filled.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: No NDPS, UAPA or PMLA section is charged.

steps.title: Abhiyojak argues the other side
steps.caption: Abhiyojak, the prosecution sparring partner, raised 10 objections in 2 rounds, each grounded in a prosecution argument from comparable orders or a fact of the case; 3 ungrounded objections were discarded. After Vakeel's replies: 10 unanswered.

filled.label: O1 against G1 (gravity and punishment)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The defence's reliance on the maximum punishment of five years to argue that the offence does not fall in Antil category A is misplaced; the gravity of the offence, including that it is a non-bailable offence under BNS 316(2) equivalent to IPC 406, remains a…

filled.label: O2 against G2 (antecedents)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The defence's reliance on the Rajasthan High Court order is misplaced because the precedent does not apply where the accused has prior criminal antecedents that establish a pattern of habitual offending.

filled.label: O3 against G2 (antecedents)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The defence ignores that the applicant has no verifiable antecedents on record, and the absence of stated antecedents does not negate the prosecution's duty to oppose bail where the offence is serious and the applicant remains in custody.

filled.label: O4 against G3 (flight risk)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant's assertion of strong community ties is undermined by the fact that the employer holds the cash book and bank statements, and the amount is disputed, suggesting financial motive and opportunity to flee with evidence or funds.

filled.label: O5 against G4 (witness tampering)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant does not hold a passport, which reduces the risk of flight, but the defence has not provided any undertaking or evidence of ties to the jurisdiction beyond a rental flat, and the offence is non-bailable with a maximum punishment of 5 years, warr…

filled.label: O6 against G6 (health age family)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The offence is non-bailable under BNS 316(2) with maximum punishment of 5 years, and the charge sheet has not yet been filed, indicating the investigation is still ongoing and the prosecution case is not yet complete.

filled.label: O7 against G6 (health age family)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The applicant does not hold a passport and is not a foreign national, but the absence of a passport is not dispositive; the prosecution must still assess whether the accused has sufficient ties to the jurisdiction to ensure appearance.

filled.label: O8 against general (witness tampering)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The prosecution has examined several witnesses and there is a possibility that the accused may attempt to influence or tamper with evidence and witnesses if released on bail.

filled.label: O9 against general (antecedents)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: No criminal antecedents are stated, but the prosecution must still satisfy the court that the accused's antecedents do not indicate a pattern of criminal conduct that would make bail unsafe.

filled.label: O10 against general (statutory bar)
filled.value: UNANSWERED: The charge sheet has not been filed and the applicant has been in custody for 40 days, which raises concerns about the stage of investigation and the potential for statutory bars to apply if the investigation is not complete.
